Asset type: Victoria 3 chemical plant square building UI icon.

Primary request: Replace ONLY the background industrial scene in Image 1 to match the vanilla icons' high, downward-looking viewpoint. KEEP the foreground terracotta pot with green plant, all four chemistry bottles/flasks, their arrangement, their colors, detailed shape, size and lower-right placement, the wooden foreground support, and the existing square rounded metallic border EXACTLY UNCHANGED. Do not redesign these foreground identifiers.
Background correction: A closely cropped brick chemical factory viewed from HIGH ABOVE at a steep downward angle of about 60 degrees, near bird's eye three-quarter view. Show predominantly large diagonal slate-gray factory roof planes with skylight ridges and glimpses of a cobbled service yard and brick wall edges between roof planes, like image 2. We are looking DOWN onto the factory, not standing at its entrance. Fill the entire space behind the existing foreground objects and inside the frame with this aerial roof/courtyard scene. A brick chimney top can appear only as seen from above, subordinate to the roof geometry. Darkened industrial background, muted slate, charcoal, warm brick, ochre, painterly vanilla building UI finish with coherent shadows. Background must remain subordinate to the colorful foreground objects at thumbnail size.
Composition: SAME square icon and exact foreground/framing as image 1. Steep diagonal roofs cropped by border, no panoramic wide landscape, no miniature full factory model floating in open space. Preserve the original border and transparent external corner pixels; everything INSIDE the frame remains opaque.
Avoid: ground-level view, factory entrance viewpoint, horizon, sky, frontal architectural portrait, new foreground props, text, labels, new bottles, missing bottles, logos, watermark. This is a UI building icon, not a photorealistic scene or blueprint. Output one edited square image.
